title: Normalize node content to a single formula field (literal constants are no-= formulas)
description:
Decision (user-directed): a node has ONE content field, 'formula'. Excel cell-input convention: a leading = introduces a formula; any other input is a literal constant that OxFml parses during bind and resolves to a typed EvalValue (number/text/logical/date/error) with Excel-aligned type inference. There is no separate 'literal value' content kind. Without =, the whole input is a constant even if it looks like a name (typing Margin = the text "Margin", not a reference); with =, Margin is a reference. Matches Excel exactly.

Scope:
- CORE_MODEL_SPEC: rewrite section 2 node-content bullet; adjust section 6 array-literal line; add a section 6 engine-prerequisite for constant-input parsing; note in section 9 grammar; line in section 5 (value entry follows Excel).
- Corpus: normalize literal node formulas in workspaces/accounts.json + meta-demo.json to bare constants (=0.2 -> 0.2 etc); keep =-formulas; keep import cases verbatim (section 10 zero-rewriting preserves Excel = text). Update schema + README. Re-run validate-corpus.ps1.
- Handover: docs/handovers/HANDOVER_OXFML_constant_input.md - OxFml accepts no-= input as a constant and resolves type+value during parse/bind (OxFunc value parsing; Excel-aligned implicit number-format inference).
- Consistency ripples (specs modelling SEPARATE literal storage/kind): interop EXCEL_EXPORT_AND_REPLAY phrasing; ux/TECHNICAL literal_value field; ux/SKINS NodeState.literal_value + SetLiteralValue/ConvertToLiteral intents; ux/REQUIREMENTS 3.6. Reconcile to single-formula model; preserve editing affordances reframed as constant-vs-formula by leading =. (May split UX reconciliation into a follow-up bead if large.)

Acceptance: validate-corpus.ps1 green; no remaining 'formula OR literal value' dual-storage language in CORE_MODEL_SPEC; handover file present; read-through.
close_reason: Node content normalized to a single formula field. CORE_MODEL_SPEC §2/§5/§6/§9 updated; ux/TECHNICAL+SKINS+REQUIREMENTS+interop reconciled (no separate literal_value field/intent); OxFml handover authored. Checks: validate-corpus.ps1 green (60 cases), grep shows no residual dual-storage language. Corpus-fixture normalization rides with the example-set bead dtc-z0i.1 (uncommitted, pending its review).

title: Spec: circular references + iterative calculation (host-configured cycle profiles)
description:
Decision (user-directed): the spec must cater for circular references. Cycles are first-class and profile-governed with host-supplied configuration, Excel-aligned (not merely an error). Grounded in OxCalc W048 (docs/spec/core-engine/w048-cycles): three profiles - non_iterative_stage1 (default: reject, cycle_blocked, prior values retained), excel_match_iterative (Excel-faithful, chain-ordered sequential, MaxIterations + max-change 0.001; named blockers, not yet universal), iterative_deterministic_v0 (Jacobi, 100 iters / 0.001). OxCalc lists "TreeCalc implementation of cycle.excel_match_iterative" as an open lane and already has a treecalc.rs publish path + fixtures.

Scope:
- CORE_MODEL_SPEC: new section 7a "Circular References and Iterative Calculation" (three profiles, default non-iterative = Excel default; host-supplied config: profile selection + Maximum Iterations + Maximum Change, persisted at workspace level like the capability profile, conveyed to OxCalc via the compatibility basis). Cross-ref from section 3.2 self-reference bullet. Engine-prereq item 12 in section 6. Pointer from section 7 calc-state.
- Handover: docs/handovers/HANDOVER_OXCALC_iterative_cycle_config.md - confirm host-config contract (profile + bounds via compatibility basis/capability snapshot) and circular-reference diagnostic surface back (CircularReference equivalent, cycle_iteration_trace).

Boundary: iteration semantics + convergence + Excel-match values are Excel-anchored (OxCalc W048); TreeCalc owns the config surface + persistence + UX. Corpus cycle cases are a follow-up extension to the example-set corpus (dtc-z0i.1).

Acceptance: read-through; section 7a present + cross-refs resolve; handover present; no contradiction with OxCalc W048 TreeCalc cycle doc.
close_reason: Spec now caters for circular references. CORE_MODEL_SPEC §7a added (cycle profiles non_iterative_stage1/excel_match_iterative/iterative_deterministic_v0; host-supplied workspace config: profile + Maximum Iterations + Maximum Change, Excel-aligned, conveyed via the compatibility basis), plus §3.2 cross-ref, §6 engine-prereq item 12, §7 pointer. Handover HANDOVER_OXCALC_iterative_cycle_config authored; handovers/README index reconciled to topic-specific engine-prereq handovers. Consistent with OxCalc W048. Check: doctrine read-through; section order intact (§7→§7a→§7b); cross-refs resolve.

title: W002 scaffolding: TreeCalc test-corpus framework + shared workspace fixtures + spec-derived seed
description:
Outcome: the reusable TreeCalc test-corpus scaffolding exists under docs/test-corpus/ (family convention; cf. OxCalc/OxReplay/OxXlPlay docs/test-corpus), plus a pwsh well-formedness validator and a spec-derived seed of cases that exercises it.

Why under W002: W002's verification line names "a minimal multi-node workspace fixture" + "bridge test harness". The corpus framework + shared workspace fixtures ARE that scaffolding. Authoring it has no engine dependency, so it is unblocked. W004 (references) and W008 (import) are blocked and will EXTEND this corpus with full case coverage later.

Boundary (confirmed against OxCalc): OxCalc's own corpus is the abstract TraceCalc coordinator schema (candidate/publish/reject, pinned views, counters) - engine mechanics with fake exprs, never the reference surface. TreeCalc's corpus pins the complement: path-syntax -> engine-reference mapping, walk-up resolution outcomes, profile gating, import mapping. Function/operator/value/format/date/error semantics stay Excel-anchored in OxFunc/OxFml/OxCalc + OxReplay; never reimplemented here. Engine gaps -> handovers.

Format: canonical JSON aligned to TraceCalc idioms (schema_version, stable field names, nodes[].node_id). Atomic resolution rows grouped into themed files; shared trees as workspace fixtures.

Layout:
- docs/test-corpus/README.md - how we test; the boundary; conventions; runner contract; gate-tier mapping.
- docs/test-corpus/schema/*.schema.json - case + workspace JSON schemas.
- docs/test-corpus/workspaces/ - shared multi-node tree fixtures (the W002 fixture).
- docs/test-corpus/references/ - walk-up, anchors, sibling-offsets, classification (single/set), meta invisibility, !-alias (CORE_MODEL_SPEC s3).
- docs/test-corpus/profiles/ - treecalc-v1 vs strict-excel accept/reject (s4).
- docs/test-corpus/import/ - Excel defined-name -> tree + stub policy (s10).
- docs/test-corpus/tools/validate-corpus.ps1 - parse + invariant checks.
- docs/SPEC.md pointer to the corpus.

Acceptance check: pwsh docs/test-corpus/tools/validate-corpus.ps1 exits 0 and reports seeded case/workspace counts; read-through confirms each case cites its CORE_MODEL_SPEC section.

Runner contract (later W002 bead): the executable runner binds these cases to the OxCalcTree bridge per OxCalc docs/spec/core-engine/CORE_ENGINE_OXCALCTREE_CONSUMER_INTERFACE_AND_HOST_CONTRACT_V1.md and CORE_ENGINE_TEST_VALIDATOR_AND_RUNNER_CONTRACT.md.
